title: Sycophancy steering vector replicated across an architecture family it wasn't tested on

original_idea.body: Replicate the sycophancy probe/steering pipeline on Mistral-7B-Instruct and Phi-3-mini, measuring probe detection accuracy and sycophancy reduction vs published Qwen/DeepSeek numbers.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: sycophancy (fuzzy-reward failure) control generalization is useful, but replication has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Replicate with public datasets on small models; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped replication with clear comparison numbers.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Fuzzy-reward alignment failure labs deprioritize, open models.

low_compute.reasoning: Linear probe + inference on small models.

novelty.reasoning: Direct cross-family replication of an existing recipe; largely addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Mostly a replication of existing results.
